title: hamiltonians-figure widget params
description: Shared figure shape for the 6 widgets on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic. Unifies the common chrome — header, SVG host, readout, and chained input rows that may sit on either side of the SVG — and discriminates the bespoke physics into bodyScript as the only artifact field. Replaces the per-widget hamiltonians-canonical-transform / hamiltonians-conserved-quantity / hamiltonians-flow-portrait / hamiltonians-kam-tori / hamiltonians-kepler-orbits / hamiltonians-phase-space-cell slugs.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget">.

title.description: Header title text. HTML-escaped on render.

hint.description: Optional header hint text. HTML-escaped on render.

ariaLabel.description: aria-label on <svg>; the source prefers this over a <title> child.

initial.description: Initial readout body — may carry KaTeX delimiters.

preRows.description: Control rows rendered BEFORE the SVG. Each row is one <div class="row"> holding a sequence of controls.

postRows.description: Control rows rendered AFTER the SVG and BEFORE the output readout.

sectionComment.description: ARTIFACT. Optional /* ... */ banner inserted between the leading <script> tag and the IIFE opener.

bodyScript.description: ARTIFACT. Per-widget physics — integrators, draw routines, event handlers — emitted verbatim inside `(function(){\n…\n})();`. The 6 widgets' physics differ enough that absorbing them into structured params would be over-engineering; portable consumers must re-implement from {svg, output, preRows, postRows} plus their own integrator.

controls.description: Mixed-type controls, rendered in order at 4-space indent inside the <div class="row">.

trailing.description: Optional inline HTML appended to the end of the row, after the last control. Typically a ….

label.description: <label for=ID> text. Emitted verbatim — no HTML escaping (KaTeX-bearing labels are common).

trailing.description: ARTIFACT. Raw bytes inserted into the <option> open tag after the value (and selected) attributes — used to preserve a stray space the original source carries on certain options.

label.description: Button visible text. Emitted verbatim (KaTeX-bearing labels are common).
